negative_result_guard: This is a positive localization/closure result only. It does not identify a causal instability mechanism, establish nonlinear MUSCL stability, improve the failed endpoint, or validate the cavity benchmark. Stage 99 remains a negative cross-run reproducibility result, Stage 98 remains a negative cross-run replay result, Stage 90 remains nonconverged in both reconstruction arms, Stage 28 remains a failed MUSCL endpoint, and the Stage-89 one-sided boundary slope is not promoted. No failed physical or numerical parameter is retuned.
scientific_conclusion: The frozen interior MUSCL-correction growth is angularly diffuse rather than concentrated in one common 45-degree velocity sector. Every sector grows materially over the 25-step window: phi weighted-absolute growth ranges from 4.2859x to 5.5966x and psi from 3.9118x to 4.8406x. The largest final phi shares are -x-y at 25.3198% and +x-y at 24.9366%; the corresponding largest psi shares are only 19.8942% and 19.4803%, so no sector reaches the preregistered 25% dominance threshold in both distributions. This supports the preregistered radial-speed-shell audit, but does not prove causality or solver error.
